chose: controlled Base UI tooltip + touch-only click toggle on the recipe tag chips
over: swapping Tooltip for Popover on the chips
making the chip a real <button> to get native focus/tap
because: Base UI tooltip is hover(mouseOnly)+focus(:focus-visible) by construction, so no iOS event sequence could ever open it; controlling open adds a third path without touching desktop hover. Popover would have rewritten the a11y semantics of a purely supplementary provenance line; a <button> chip crosses badgeVariants' 44px touch floor and would inflate every tag in the strip (bcf1cfd scoped that floor to :is(a,button) deliberately).

chose: Infotip (Base UI Popover + openOnHover) for derived tag chips, replacing the controlled-Tooltip toggle
over: controlled Tooltip open state toggled on touch pointerType
because: Base UI documents that tooltips are disabled on touch on purpose and prescribes Popover+openOnHover for infotips (docs/react/components/tooltip.md:425); their trigger-purpose test puts a provenance chip on the popover side. Popover also brings aria-expanded/aria-controls/role=dialog disclosure semantics a hover-only aria-describedby never gave touch or SR users, and PopoverPopup disables its focus manager when the open reason is triggerHover so desktop hover still behaves like a tooltip. Kept: span trigger + nativeButton={false} (button element would cross badgeVariants' 44px touch floor), cursor-pointer for Safari click synthesis.
